settings.description_override: The Colette belongs to crisp mornings, long lunches and the coat you return to every autumn. A softly structured brushed-wool body meets smooth leather at the handles and belted front, with warm gold details catching the light. Tactile and quietly expressive, it brings a little softness to a full day.
settings.fact_detail: Made by artisans with 10 years of experience

settings.heading: Details
settings.content: An open top and broad side gussets give the Colette its generous silhouette. Leather wraps the upper handle arcs, and the front belt ends fall separately, each finished with a round gold-tone cap. Approximate dimensions are 50 × 26 × 18 cm (W × H × D), with a 16 cm handle drop.

settings.heading: Care
settings.content: Brush the wool gently with a soft garment brush, following the nap. Spot-clean with a barely damp cloth and let it dry naturally. Wipe the leather trim with a dry cloth and store the bag away from direct heat and sunlight.

settings.heading: Shipping & delivery
settings.content: Colette is available to pre-order in all colors, with stock expected to arrive in October 2026. Your order will dispatch once stock arrives. Delivery time is additional and varies by destination. We will send tracking details when it ships. See our shipping policy for delivery information.

settings.heading: Returns
settings.content: Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery for unused items in their original packaging with tags attached. To arrange a return, contact customerservice@velantrafashion.com. See our return policy for full conditions.
